name: eskais-character
description: Local, in-browser engine that turns photos into a stylised, rigged character with a face.

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings -c tooling/oxlint-type-aware.json src tooling test
scripts.guards: bun tooling/check-images.ts --rerender && node tooling/check-licences.mjs && node tooling/check-lockfile.mjs
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run guards && bun run deps:age && bun run test:browser && bun run perf:ci
scripts.calibrate: bun tooling/calibrate/face-landmarks.ts && bun tooling/calibrate/detect-set.ts --seed=2000 --count=32 && bun tooling/calibrate/body.ts --write && bun tooling/calibrate/detect-set.ts --seed=4000 --count=300 && bun tooling/calibrate/train-priors.ts --seed=4000 && bun tooling/calibrate/hair-thresholds.ts
scripts.evaluate: bun tooling/calibrate/detect-set.ts --seed=1 --count=24 && bun tooling/calibrate/eval-face.ts --seed=1 && bun tooling/calibrate/body.ts --seed=1 && bun tooling/calibrate/colors.ts --seed=4000
